findings.text: Reference wiring: the live deployer is unexercised in the home gate by design; the promote-only-if-healthy and rollback-to-last-good invariants are proven with the fake deployer and a promote-anyway mutant that fails the health invariant.

summary: X7 (WARP-0407, release and rollback automation) is correct and honest. Independent adversarial review: pass_with_notes, gate GREEN, control logic driven independently (healthy promotes through full and sets flags with no rollback; unhealthy canary halts ok=False and rolls back to baseline with the new flow disabled; mid-stage failure rolls back to last-good; rollback idempotent). Non-tautology 10/10 (invert gate, promote-anyway, gate-respected-true, skip rollback, skip reconcile, rollback-to-baseline-always and more all caught). Reference status honest (no deploy surface in the home gate; live path fails loud); proportionate (stdlib seam, no bespoke deploy stack); both capabilities.yaml copies byte-identical; generic; ASCII. proof_digest recomputed via validate.py.
